_meta.note: User-voice agricultural questions only. Translations are UNVALIDATED (machine-drafted); native-speaker review is a dossier ask to Way With Words. lang codes: en af xh zu sw.

questions.en: How many plants are there in this field?
questions.af: Hoeveel plante is daar in hierdie land?
questions.xh: Zingaphi izityalo kule ntsimi?
questions.sw: Kuna mimea mingapi katika shamba hili?

questions.en: Which rows look like they are struggling?
questions.af: Watter rye lyk of hulle sukkel?
questions.xh: Yeyiphi imigca ebonakala isokola?
questions.sw: Ni safu zipi zinazoonekana kutaabika?

questions.en: Are any plants missing along row 7?
questions.af: Is daar plante wat langs ry 7 ontbreek?
questions.xh: Ingaba zikho izityalo ezingekhoyo kumgca 7?
questions.sw: Je, kuna mimea inayokosekana kwenye safu ya 7?

questions.en: Where should I start my inspection this morning?
questions.af: Waar moet ek vanoggend my inspeksie begin?
questions.xh: Ndiqale phi ukuhlola kwam ngale ntsasa?
questions.zu: Ngiqale kuphi ukuhlola kwami namhlanje ekuseni?
questions.sw: Nianzie wapi ukaguzi wangu asubuhi ya leo?

questions.en: Compare row 3 and row 9 - which looks healthier?
questions.af: Vergelyk ry 3 en ry 9 - watter een lyk gesonder?
questions.xh: Thelekisa umgca 3 nomgca 9 - nguwuphi obonakala usempilweni ngakumbi?
questions.zu: Qhathanisa umugqa 3 nomugqa 9 - yimuphi obukeka unempilo kangcono?
questions.sw: Linganisha safu ya 3 na safu ya 9 - ipi inaonekana yenye afya zaidi?

questions.en: How is that plant doing?
questions.af: Hoe gaan dit met daardie plant?
questions.xh: Siqhuba njani eso sityalo?
questions.sw: Ule mmea unaendeleaje?

questions.en: Do the trees need watering today?
questions.af: Moet die bome vandag natgemaak word?
questions.xh: Ingaba imithi ifuna ukunkcenkceshelwa namhlanje?
questions.sw: Je, miti inahitaji kumwagiliwa leo?

questions.en: Send someone to pull out the dead plant in row 2.
questions.af: Stuur iemand om die dooie plant in ry 2 uit te trek.
questions.xh: Thumela umntu aze akhuphe isityalo esifileyo kumgca 2.
questions.zu: Thumela umuntu azokhipha isitshalo esifile emgqeni 2.
questions.sw: Tuma mtu akang'oe mmea uliokufa kwenye safu ya 2.

questions.en: When was this field last surveyed?
questions.af: Wanneer is hierdie land laas opgemeet?
questions.xh: Yayigqityelwe nini ukuphononongwa le ntsimi?
questions.sw: Shamba hili lilipimwa mara ya mwisho lini?

questions.en: Is the whole farm in the 3D view, or are parts missing?
questions.af: Is die hele plaas in die 3D-aansig, of ontbreek dele?
questions.xh: Ingaba yonke ifama ikwimbonakalo ye-3D, okanye kukho iindawo ezingekhoyo?
questions.zu: Ingabe lonke ipulazi likumbukiso we-3D, noma kukhona izingxenye ezingekho?
questions.sw: Je, shamba lote liko kwenye mwonekano wa 3D, au kuna sehemu zinazokosekana?

questions.en: How complete is the view of row 5?
questions.af: Hoe volledig is die aansig van ry 5?
questions.xh: Igqibelele kangakanani imbonakalo yomgca 5?
questions.sw: Mwonekano wa safu ya 5 umekamilika kwa kiasi gani?

questions.en: Why does that end of the field look worse in the viewer?
questions.af: Hoekom lyk daardie kant van die land slegter in die kyker?
questions.xh: Kutheni elo cala lentsimi libonakala libi ngakumbi kumboniseli?
questions.zu: Kungani lolo hlangothi lwensimu lubukeka lubi kakhulu kumbukisi?
questions.sw: Kwa nini upande ule wa shamba unaonekana mbaya zaidi kwenye kionyeshi?

questions.en: Show me the trees at the end of row 2 up close.
questions.af: Wys my die bome aan die einde van ry 2 van naby.
questions.xh: Ndibonise imithi esekupheleni komgca 2 kufuphi.
questions.sw: Nionyeshe miti iliyo mwishoni mwa safu ya 2 kwa karibu.

questions.en: Is the scan any good?
questions.af: Is die skandering enigsins goed?
questions.xh: Ingaba uskeni ulungile?
questions.sw: Je, skani ni nzuri?

questions.en: What did this field look like five years ago?
questions.af: Hoe het hierdie land vyf jaar gelede gelyk?
questions.xh: Yayikhangeleka njani le ntsimi kwiminyaka emihlanu eyadlulayo?
questions.zu: Yayibukeka kanjani le nsimu eminyakeni emihlanu edlule?
questions.sw: Shamba hili lilionekanaje miaka mitano iliyopita?

questions.en: Book a new survey flight for tomorrow morning.
questions.af: Bespreek 'n nuwe opmetingsvlug vir moreoggend.
questions.xh: Bhukisha uhambo olutsha lophononongo ngomso kusasa.
questions.zu: Bhuka uhambo olusha lokuhlola kusasa ekuseni.
questions.sw: Panga safari mpya ya upimaji kesho asubuhi.

questions.en: Have these trees grown since the last visit?
questions.af: Het hierdie bome gegroei sedert die laaste besoek?
questions.xh: Ingaba le mithi ikhulile ukusukela kutyelelo lokugqibela?
questions.zu: Ingabe lezi zihlahla zikhulile kusukela ekuvakasheni kokugcina?
questions.sw: Je, miti hii imekua tangu ziara ya mwisho?

questions.en: Which trees have changed the most since January?
questions.af: Watter bome het die meeste verander sedert Januarie?
questions.xh: Yeyiphi imithi etshintshe kakhulu ukususela ngoJanuwari?
questions.zu: Yiziphi izihlahla ezishintshe kakhulu kusukela ngoJanuwari?
questions.sw: Ni miti ipi iliyobadilika zaidi tangu Januari?

questions.en: Is anything here now that was not here in the previous survey?
questions.af: Is daar nou iets hier wat nie in die vorige opmeting was nie?
questions.xh: Ingaba kukho into ekhoyo ngoku eyayingekho kuphononongo lwangaphambili?
questions.zu: Ingabe kukhona okukhona manje okwakungekho ekuhlolweni kwangaphambilini?
questions.sw: Je, kuna kitu kilichopo sasa ambacho hakikuwepo katika upimaji uliopita?

questions.en: Are any trees getting worse over time?
questions.af: Word enige bome mettertyd slegter?
questions.xh: Ingaba ikho imithi eya isiba mandundu ngokuhamba kwexesha?
questions.zu: Ingabe kukhona izihlahla eziya ziba zimbi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
questions.sw: Je, kuna miti inayozidi kuwa mibaya kadri muda unavyopita?

questions.en: When were these trees last observed?
questions.af: Wanneer is hierdie bome laas waargeneem?
questions.xh: Yayigqityelwe nini ukubonwa le mithi?
questions.sw: Miti hii iliangaliwa mara ya mwisho lini?

questions.en: What changed?
questions.af: Wat het verander?
questions.xh: Yintoni etshintshileyo?
questions.sw: Nini kimebadilika?

questions.en: Will this season's yield be better than last year's?
questions.af: Sal hierdie seisoen se oes beter wees as verlede jaar s'n?
questions.xh: Ingaba isivuno salo nyaka siza kuba ngcono kunesonyaka ophelileyo?
questions.zu: Ingabe isivuno salesi sizini sizoba ngcono kunesonyaka odlule?
questions.sw: Je, mavuno ya msimu huu yatakuwa bora kuliko ya mwaka jana?

questions.en: If that tree has not grown by next month, flag it for removal.
questions.af: As daardie boom teen volgende maand nie gegroei het nie, merk dit vir verwydering.
questions.xh: Ukuba loo mthi awukhulanga ngenyanga ezayo, wuphawule ukuze ususwe.
questions.zu: Uma leso sihlahla singakhulile ngenyanga ezayo, siphawule ukuze sisuswe.
questions.sw: Ikiwa mti ule haujakua ifikapo mwezi ujao, uwekee alama ya kuondolewa.

questions.en: Take me to row 4.
questions.af: Neem my na ry 4.
questions.xh: Ndise kumgca 4.
questions.sw: Nipeleke kwenye safu ya 4.

questions.en: Walk me along row 7 from one end to the other.
questions.af: Stap saam met my langs ry 7 van die een kant na die ander.
questions.xh: Ndihambise ecaleni komgca 7 ukusuka kwelinye icala ukuya kwelinye.
questions.zu: Ngihambise emugqeni 7 kusuka kolunye uhlangothi kuya kolunye.
questions.sw: Nitembeze kando ya safu ya 7 kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwingine.

questions.en: Show me the plant nearest the gate.
questions.af: Wys my die plant naaste aan die hek.
questions.xh: Ndibonise isityalo esikufuphi nesango.
questions.sw: Nionyeshe mmea ulio karibu zaidi na lango.

questions.en: Go to the tree.
questions.af: Gaan na die boom.
questions.xh: Yiya emthini.
questions.sw: Nenda kwenye mti.

questions.en: How is plant number 300 doing?
questions.af: Hoe gaan dit met plant nommer 300?
questions.xh: Siqhuba njani isityalo esingunombolo 300?
questions.sw: Mmea namba 300 unaendeleaje?

questions.en: How is plant number 700 doing?
questions.af: Hoe gaan dit met plant nommer 700?
questions.xh: Siqhuba njani isityalo esingunombolo 700?
questions.sw: Mmea namba 700 unaendeleaje?

questions.xh: Ndicela u-checke i-row 7 - are any plants missing?
Yeyiphi imigca esokolayo - please give me a quick summary.

questions.af: Kan jy check of ry 3 gesond lyk? Just the short answer please.
Hoeveel plante is in die veld? Just a number please.

pass_c_followups.en: Where does that information come from, and how fresh is it?
pass_c_followups.xh: Olo lwazi luvela phi, yaye lutsha kangakanani?

pass_c_followups.en: Where does that information come from, and how fresh is it?
pass_c_followups.xh: Olo lwazi luvela phi, yaye lutsha kangakanani?

pass_c_followups.en: Yes, go ahead and do it.
I mean the third plant from the gate end of row 2.
